title: Team, roles and single sign-on into the OTA admin
summary: The owner invites a member with a role, the member signs up with the invited address and opens the console by SSO; roles change what the console allows; removal and 'sign out everywhere' end console sessions within a minute.
prerequisites: An active OTA of yours ([[journey:signup-and-provision]]) and the console reachable ([[journey:storefront-settings-and-markups]]).
Two browsers or profiles: one for the owner, one for the member. A second invented address such as `member1@example.com`.

steps.title: Invite a member as agent
steps.actions: On **Team** type **E-mail address** `member1@example.com`, choose **Role** *agent*, press **Send the invitation**.
steps.expect: *The invitation is on its way.* The **Pending invitations** table lists the address, *Agent* and you as inviter. Mailpit: "`<owner name>` invited you to `<OTA>` on Velexis".
steps.data: `SELECT email, role, status, expires_at FROM platform.tenant_invitations WHERE tenant_id = 'ten_…';` → `pending`, 7 days; `email_outbox` row; audit row.

steps.title: Another account cannot accept
steps.actions: In the owner's browser (signed in as the owner) open the invitation link from Mailpit.
steps.expect: The page explains the invitation is for another address (`INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH`) and offers to sign out and continue with the invited address. Nothing changes.

steps.title: The invited person signs up and accepts
steps.actions: In the member's browser open the link and press **Create an account** (the invited address is prefilled). Verify through Mailpit in the same browser, sign in on `/sign-in?verified=1&next=%2Finvitations%2Faccept` and press **Accept the invitation** on the invitation page you are back on.
steps.expect: The page "Join `<OTA>`" shows the OTA, the role, the inviter, the invited address and the link's expiry (the token is moved into a 15-minute httpOnly cookie and removed from the URL). After verifying, the browser lands on `/sign-in?verified=1&next=%2Finvitations%2Faccept`, and signing in returns to the invitation ("You are signed in as …"). After **Accept the invitation** the member lands on the OTA's overview `/otas/ten_…` with the role *Agent*, and `/dashboard` lists the OTA.

steps.title: The member opens the console
steps.actions: As the member press **Open console**. Open a booking if the OTA has one (a new OTA has none: book one first, for example with [[journey:book-with-stripe]]), then **Settings → Markup rules**.
steps.expect: `/bookings` of this OTA. An agent sees **Issue tickets** and **Cancel the booking** but not settings writes: *New markup rule* is disabled with *Needs the permission settings:write*; `/settings/markups/new` is refused naming the permission.
steps.data: Redis `staffsess:<familyId>`; `staff_actions` rows with `outcome = denied` for refused calls.

steps.title: Change the member to viewer
steps.actions: As the owner change the member's role to *viewer*. As the member reload the booking page.
steps.expect: The viewer sees no booking actions (no **Booking actions**, no Issue, no Cancel), the settings read-only, and only the TEST badge (no environment switch).

steps.title: A console link works once
steps.actions: As the member press **Open console** again, then use the browser's Back button to the hand-off page and submit it again (or wait more than 60 seconds on it before it submits).
steps.expect: `/sso` answers 401 with *This console link expired or was already used*; no new staff cookie is set; a fresh **Open console** works.

steps.title: Removing the member ends their console session
steps.actions: As the owner remove the member (confirm). As the member keep navigating in the console for up to a minute.
steps.expect: Within 60 seconds (usually at once) the member's next page sends them to the portal's console page; the console session cannot be renewed. The member's portal dashboard no longer lists the OTA.
steps.data: `tenant_memberships.status = removed` (the row stays: `stf_` ids are referenced by `staff_actions`); `member:<accountId>:<tenantId>` cache entry gone.

steps.title: The last owner is protected
steps.actions: As the owner try to change your own role or remove yourself.
steps.expect: Refused: the last active owner cannot be demoted or removed (`LAST_OWNER`).

steps.title: Sign out everywhere reaches the console
steps.actions: As the owner open the console in two browsers, then use sign out everywhere on the portal's security page. Navigate in both consoles.
steps.expect: Both consoles send you to the portal at the next page and cannot refresh.
steps.data: Redis `staffdeny:acct:<accountId>` holds the cut-off (30-day TTL); portal refresh families revoked in `platform.account_sessions`.
